prompts.agent:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production cartoon animation cel sheet, genuine transparent background. Edit target: supplied teal robot full-body standing cel. Preserve this exact approved character: squat teal body, giant curled brown mustache, backward mustard baseball cap and two antennae, cream oval eyes, charcoal textured zip vest, blue lanyard and blank badge, big white sneakers, same hand-drawn colored-pencil / midcentury cartoon linework. Do not redesign the character.
Create SIX distinct FULL-BODY expression cels in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, equal-sized cells, at the same scale, feet on a consistent baseline within each row. All face LEFT in the same three-quarter pose as the reference. Preserve head outline, hat position, torso, waist, legs and shoes as closely as possible across all six; change eyebrows, pupils, and specified hand gestures. Leave at least 90px TRANSPARENT gutters; no overlap or clipped extremities.
Reading order:
1. SEARCH DOWN-LEFT: eyes actively looking down-left toward a nearby box, concentrated slightly lowered brows; both hands in original positions, left holds original cream note, right hangs at side.
2. SEARCH UP-LEFT: pupils looking up-left, one eyebrow lifted, skeptical closed mouth behind mustache; both hands exactly as cel 1.
3. THINKING: furrowed eyebrows, pupils down-left, the normally hanging RIGHT hand now touches the underside of the mustache/chin thoughtfully with curled fingers; left hand still holds the note.
4. CHIN STROKE: same thinking pose as cel 3, right fingertips moved slightly upward to stroke the mustache, eyes looking sideways left, one brow raised. Keep body and feet identical.
5. BLINK: same stance and hand positions as cel 1, both eyelids fully closed in two expressive curved lines, brows thoughtful.
6. FOUND IT: eyebrows lift, eyes brighten and look left, delighted expression, right index finger raised beside cheek in a clear 'aha!' gesture, left hand still holds the note.
The face changes must be obvious and expressive at small animation size. Keep the bulky mustache intact. No background, floor, shadows, text, numbers, labels, grid lines, other characters, props beyond the existing note. True alpha transparency.
prompts.human:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production animation cel sheet on genuine transparent background. Edit target: supplied LEFT-facing full-body human cartoon cel. Preserve the exact approved goofy tech-worker character: enormous brown curly broccoli hair, long nose, big ears, beige hoodie with hands hanging at his sides, blue lanyard and blank badge, cropped black trousers, white socks and gigantic white sneakers. Same hand-drawn colored-pencil midcentury cartoon linework, same proportions, hunched posture and clothing. Not a new character.
Create SIX FULL-BODY cels in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid. Equal-sized cells, identical scale, feet on the same baseline within each row. All bodies face LEFT exactly like the input. Change ONLY facial expression, eye direction, subtle head tilt. Keep torso, arms, legs and feet fixed so poses can swap during animation. At least 90px transparent gutters, no overlap, entire hair and both shoes visible.
Reading order:
1. ATTENTIVE: mouth a small closed smile, relaxed brows, eyes looking slightly DOWN and LEFT at a nearby short agent.
2. FOLLOWING: eyes looking LEVEL and LEFT, eyebrows raised with curiosity, mouth slightly open in a small 'oh'.
3. PUZZLED: one eyebrow raised and one furrowed, eyes DOWN and LEFT, mouth closed and slightly crooked, gently puzzled rather than angry.
4. LOOKING DEEPER: chin tilted just slightly upward, pupils clearly UP and LEFT, brows mildly concerned, small thoughtful closed mouth.
5. BLINK: same head angle as cel 4, both eyes closed naturally, neutral mouth.
6. RELIEVED: eyes looking UP and LEFT, warm relieved grin, brows relaxed, same pose and no gesture.
Make eye direction and eyebrows visibly distinct. Do not beautify or change his face, hair, outfit, hands, stance or age. No scenery, floor, shadows, text, numbers, labels, cell borders, other characters or new props. True alpha transparency.
